main_inputs: Frozen released AVI and CSV only; no private ID mapping, original OOF labels, or legacy KR caches.

metadata_policy.outliers: include stored values; disclose BMI extreme without silently dropping it
metadata_policy.any_comorbidity: dm OR htn OR dyslipidemia OR other_comorbidity_count>0; ILD separately
metadata_policy.other_comorbidity_count: Legacy column name retained; binary presence (0=none,1=at least one); user-authorized metadata-only amendment dated 2026-10-27
metadata_policy.amendment: metadata_binary_amendment_20261027; video, signals, folds and evaluation protocol unchanged

split.train_valid: non-test release participant IDs sorted lexically; first floor(0.9*N) train; remainder valid; explicit CSV
split.checkpoint: minimum validation loss; earliest epoch on ties; same selected checkpoint in every test domain

input.roi: session median of all finite, positive-area released boxes; int truncation; 1.5 enlargement and clipping to image boundaries
input.bbox_short_files: boxes are spatial ROI annotations; never truncate video or BVP to bbox row count
input.frame_policy: retained frame sequence, no temporal resampling; timestamp gaps summarized separately
input.normalization: session population moments before model-specific chunking
input.compact_cache: direct uint8 INTER_AREA crops at 36/72/128; normalize on demand from session moments; no second spatial resize

benchmark.predictions: concatenate full chunks chronologically; trim to common_frames; integrate derivative output before HR estimation

derivative_convention.label_at_index_t: BVP[t+1]-BVP[t]; divide by session difference SD for DiffNormalized
derivative_convention.clip_boundary: Read the following sample across clip boundaries; zero-pad only the final session sample
derivative_convention.prediction_reconstruction: float64 numpy.cumsum after chronological concatenation and common-interval trimming; no initial zero prepended and no sample shift
derivative_convention.reference_boundary: raw BVP[180:180+common_frames]; forward-difference reconstruction retains its one-sample boundary convention

benchmark.reference: raw released BVP on the same common interval; independent of model-specific normalized labels

hr_estimator.spectrum: periodogram, nfft next power of two, detrend=False
hr_estimator.estimate: maximum spectral power within inclusive 0.6–3.3 Hz

table7.kr: released T01 raw BVP, whole released session
table7.external: original external reference waveforms; fixed task/participant selection
table7.estimator: order-1 Butterworth 0.75–2.5 Hz, filtfilt, no smoothness detrend, whole-record next-power-of-two periodogram
table7.reason: use one descriptive HR estimator across datasets; explicitly distinguish from model benchmark

aggregation.internal: mean session absolute error within participant, then mean across participants
aggregation.figure3: task-wise participant mean; participant bootstrap B=10000 seed=42
aggregation.external: fixed per-dataset common session set; state aggregation unit and fold variability
aggregation.reference_hr_ge90: same common-interval benchmark reference, threshold inclusive 90 bpm

normalization_precision: float32 frame/difference arithmetic; float64 accumulated population moments
source_scope: Primary KR analyses consume the locally prepared frozen release described by release_identity.json. Remote publication identity has not been verified.

declared_exceptions.description: Recruitment, consent and ethics approval, acquisition procedures, and original selection or quality-control history are documented from retained study records; these historical claims are not regenerated from the distributed files.
The consented original example and additional control transformations use original study images. The released keep-ratio 0.02 example uses the actual distributed BFDT video.

Original gallery images and keep-ratio 1.0, 0.30 and 0.10 control probes require custodian access to original recordings. The keep-ratio 0.02 probe uses the actual distributed BFDT video. Only aggregate privacy results are public.

Matched original-video training and testing arms are explicit controls, separate from the primary benchmark on released BFDT videos. Original-video access is required to regenerate these control arms.

External contact waveforms, videos and fixed external-trained weights follow their respective access terms. The public release-based benchmark does not imply that every external weight has a public download.

external_benchmark.reference: Independent aligned external contact BVP on the same common interval; use the benchmark.hr_estimator definition; never use a model-specific cached label HR.
external_benchmark.cohort_source: Public benchmark/external_sources.py and the fixed UBFC_PHYS_EXCLUSION_LIST in benchmark/make_configs.py; one inventory per dataset shared across all models and outgoing folds.

aggregation_details.outgoing_kr_to_external: Mean absolute session error within each of the five KR folds, then the mean of the five fold MAEs.
aggregation_details.incoming_external_to_kr: Mean absolute session error across all 1166 released KR sessions for one fixed external-trained checkpoint per architecture.
aggregation_details.figure3_ci: Sort public participant IDs; participant percentile bootstrap with 10000 resamples and a fresh numpy default_rng(42) for each model/group cell.
aggregation_details.figure3_median_and_tail: Median absolute error and percentage with absolute error >5 bpm are session-level summaries.

table7_selection.kr: All 293 released T01 BVP waveforms, full recording; nominal30Hz.
table7_selection.pure: 10 steady task01 waveforms; sampling rate from waveform timestamps.
table7_selection.mmpd: Exactly Stationary recordings, excluding Stationary (after exercise); mean recording HR within each of33participants; reference sampling30Hz.
table7_selection.ubfc_phys: All56 resting T1 raw BVP recordings, sampled64Hz; this is distinct from the101-session benchmark cohort.

publication_note: A prepared protocol template is not evidence that remote dataset publication or all model-result generation is complete.
